title: Lower bounds on the blowup rate of vorticity in the Euler equations
summary: Under the assumption that a solution to the 3D incompressible Euler equations blows up at a time $T_\ast$ and that $T_\ast $ is the first such time, we establish lower bounds on the rate of blow-up of the maximum norm of the vorticity. In particular, when the domain is $\mathbb{R}^3$ or $\mathbb{T}^3$, we provide lower bounds on $\int_{0}^{t}\Vert ω\Vert_{L^\infty}\,ds$ and $\sup_{s\in[0,t]}\|ω\|_{L^\infty}$ for $t$ sufficiently close to~$T_\ast$.
